<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def centers(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            kid=[fr.segmentation['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            out.append((min(cs), kid if kid else 'NOCHILD'))
    return sorted(out)
print("PRE :", centers(previous_frame))
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':43}])
print("POST:", centers(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
# W bar
print("W:", previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')[63].count('W'), "->", current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[63].count('W'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
